notes: Section "Entradas e pratos principais" has TWO BOXES SIDE BY SIDE; reading order is box by box: the whole left box (Entradas) first, then the right box (Pratos principais). Tables 1 and 2 (price tables inside the boxes) have no lines at all; their first column cells have two lines (dish name, then a description) that are joined with one space. Table 3 is a boxed key/value panel without header row (opening hours). Table 4 (Sobremesas) has rules between rows only. Table 5 (Bebidas) is a small grid; "—" means no price. Lists: typed "(1)" "(2)" "(3)" "(4)" (allergens, hanging indent) and typed en-dashes "–". Masthead lines and the page lines "Página 1" and "Página 2" are furniture; the restaurant name is not a heading.
